versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the verificate skill for OpenClaw.
- Connects to the hosted Verificate MCP server, offering 25 free validations per machine with no signup required.
- Provides AI output validation, plan validation, in-depth code analysis, and gated code generation features.
- Combines 17 deterministic reality gates with a frontier-model review to catch prompt injection, false completions, invented APIs, and other issues.
- Includes clear privacy and trust guarantees; all analysis is read-only and the skill makes a single outbound call.
